pagetitle: "Proteomic GWAS Catalogue"
---

```{ojs}
catData = FileAttachment("data/catalogue.json").json()
strataAll = catData.strata
```

```{ojs}
// Helper formatters & numeric filter evaluator
platBadgeClass = p => p === "Mass Spectrometry" ? "plat-MS" : p === "Other Immunoassay" ? "plat-Other" : `plat-${p}`

dataBadgeClass = d =>
  d === "Genome-wide" ? "data-gw" :
  d === "Gene-region" ? "data-cis" :
  d === "Top-hits" ? "data-top" : "data-unavail"

curationBadgeClass = c =>
  c === "Human-curated" ? "cur-human-curated" :
  c === "Human-reviewed" ? "cur-human-reviewed" : "cur-ai-extracted"

matchNumericFilter = (val, rawExpr) => {
  const expr = (rawExpr || "").trim().replace(/,/g, "");
  if (!expr) return true;
  const m = expr.match(/^(>=|<=|>|<|=)?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)$/);
  if (m) {
    const op = m[1] || ">=";
    const num = Number(m[2]);
    if (op === ">=") return val >= num;
    if (op === "<=") return val <= num;
    if (op === ">")  return val > num;
    if (op === "<")  return val < num;
    return val === num;
  }
  return String(val).includes(expr);
}
```

```{ojs}
// Self-contained full-width Catalogue view (banner + persistent column-filterable expandable table)
{
  const state = {
    hideSuperseded: true,
    sortCol: "year",
    sortAsc: false,
    expanded: new Set(),
    filters: {
      study: "",
      cohort: "",
      overlap: "",
      pop: "",
      sex: "",
      n: "",
      sample: "",
      platform: "",
      assay: "",
      data: ""
    }
  };

  const countSpan = htl.html`<span></span>`;
  const clearBtn = htl.html`<button class="btn-pill" style="display:none;padding:0.2rem 0.55rem;font-size:0.74rem;" onclick=${() => {
    for (const k of Object.keys(state.filters)) state.filters[k] = "";
    for (const el of filterInputs) el.value = "";
    renderRows();
  }}>✕ Clear column filters</button>`;

  const hideSupCheckbox = htl.html`<input type="checkbox" checked onchange=${e => {
    state.hideSuperseded = e.target.checked;
    renderRows();
  }}>`;

  const cols = [
    { key: "study",    label: "STUDY",    align: "left"  },
    { key: "cohort",   label: "COHORT",   align: "left"  },
    { key: "overlap",  label: "OVERLAP",  align: "left"  },
    { key: "pop",      label: "POP",      align: "left"  },
    { key: "sex",      label: "SEX",      align: "left"  },
    { key: "n",        label: "N",        align: "right" },
    { key: "sample",   label: "SAMPLE",   align: "left"  },
    { key: "platform", label: "PLATFORM", align: "left"  },
    { key: "assay",    label: "ASSAY",    align: "right" },
    { key: "data",     label: "DATA",     align: "left"  }
  ];

  const sortIndicators = {};
  const sortHeaders = cols.map(col => {
    const ind = htl.html`<span style="opacity:0.55;margin-left:3px;font-size:0.68rem;">↕</span>`;
    sortIndicators[col.key] = ind;
    return htl.html`<th style="text-align:${col.align};" onclick=${() => {
      if (state.sortCol === col.key) {
        state.sortAsc = !state.sortAsc;
      } else {
        state.sortCol = col.key;
        state.sortAsc = col.key === "n" || col.key === "assay" || col.key === "study" || col.key === "overlap" ? false : true;
      }
      renderRows();
    }}>${col.label}${ind}</th>`;
  });

  const filterInputs = [];
  const makeTextFilter = (key, placeholder) => {
    const inp = htl.html`<input class="col-filter-input" type="text" placeholder=${placeholder} oninput=${e => {
      state.filters[key] = e.target.value;
      renderRows();
    }}>`;
    filterInputs.push(inp);
    return inp;
  };
  const makeSelectFilter = (key, options) => {
    const sel = htl.html`<select class="col-filter-select" onchange=${e => {
      state.filters[key] = e.target.value;
      renderRows();
    }}>
      <option value="">All</option>
      ${options.map(o => htl.html`<option value=${o}>${o}</option>`)}
    </select>`;
    filterInputs.push(sel);
    return sel;
  };

  const filterRow = htl.html`<tr class="filter-row">
    <th>${makeTextFilter("study", "Author, year, PMID...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("cohort", "UKB, INTERVAL...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("overlap", "None, >0, study...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("pop", "Ancestry...")}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("sex", ["Combined", "Female", "Male"])}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("n", ">=1000")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("sample", "Plasma, serum, CSF...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("platform", "SomaScan, Olink...")}</th>
    <th>${makeTextFilter("assay", ">=500")}</th>
    <th>${makeSelectFilter("data", ["Genome-wide", "Gene-region", "Top-hits", "Unavailable"])}</th>
  </tr>`;

  const tbody = htl.html`<tbody></tbody>`;

  function getFilteredAndSorted() {
    const f = state.filters;
    const rows = strataAll.filter(d => {
      if (state.hideSuperseded && d.status === "Superseded Preprint") return false;
      if (f.study) {
        const q = f.study.toLowerCase();
        const hay = `${d.first_author} ${d.year} ${d.pmid || ""} ${d.doi || ""} ${d.study_id} ${d.title}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      if (f.cohort && !d.cohorts_display.toLowerCase().includes(f.cohort.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.overlap) {
        const q = f.overlap.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (q === ">0" || q === "yes") {
          if (d.overlap_count === 0) return false;
        } else {
          const hay = `${d.overlap_compact} ${d.overlap_details}`.toLowerCase();
          if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
        }
      }
      if (f.pop && !`${d.ancestry_detail} ${d.ancestry_group}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.pop.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.sex && d.sex !== f.sex) return false;
      if (f.n && !matchNumericFilter(d.n_samples, f.n)) return false;
      if (f.sample && !d.sample_matrix.toLowerCase().includes(f.sample.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.platform && !`${d.platform_category} ${d.platform_version}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.platform.toLowerCase())) return false;
      if (f.assay && !matchNumericFilter(d.n_assays, f.assay)) return false;
      if (f.data && d.data_label !== f.data) return false;
      return true;
    });

    const dir = state.sortAsc ? 1 : -1;
    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      switch (state.sortCol) {
        case "study":
          return dir * ((a.year - b.year) || a.first_author.localeCompare(b.first_author));
        case "cohort":
          return dir * a.cohorts_display.localeCompare(b.cohorts_display);
        case "overlap":
          return dir * (a.overlap_count - b.overlap_count);
        case "pop":
          return dir * a.ancestry_detail.localeCompare(b.ancestry_detail);
        case "sex":
          return dir * a.sex.localeCompare(b.sex);
        case "n":
          return dir * (a.n_samples - b.n_samples);
        case "sample":
          return dir * a.sample_matrix.localeCompare(b.sample_matrix);
        case "platform":
          return dir * a.platform_version.localeCompare(b.platform_version);
        case "assay":
          return dir * (a.n_assays - b.n_assays);
        case "data":
          return dir * a.data_label.localeCompare(b.data_label);
        default:
          return dir * ((a.year - b.year) || (a.n_samples - b.n_samples));
      }
    });
    return rows;
  }

  function renderRows() {
    for (const c of cols) {
      const ind = sortIndicators[c.key];
      if (state.sortCol === c.key || (state.sortCol === "year" && c.key === "study")) {
        ind.textContent = state.sortAsc ? " ↑" : " ↓";
        ind.style.opacity = "1";
      } else {
        ind.textContent = " ↕";
        ind.style.opacity = "0.45";
      }
    }

    const anyFilter = Object.values(state.filters).some(v => v && v.trim() !== "");
    clearBtn.style.display = anyFilter ? "inline-flex" : "none";

    const rows = getFilteredAndSorted();
    const nStudies = new Set(rows.map(r => r.study_id)).size;
    countSpan.textContent = `Showing ${rows.length} strata across ${nStudies} studies · Click any row to expand details`;

    const trs = [];
    for (const d of rows) {
      const isOpen = state.expanded.has(d.stratum_id);
      const toggle = () => {
        if (state.expanded.has(d.stratum_id)) state.expanded.delete(d.stratum_id);
        else state.expanded.add(d.stratum_id);
        renderRows();
      };

      trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="data-row ${isOpen ? "is-open" : ""}" onclick=${toggle}>
        <td>
          <div style="font-weight:600;color:#0f172a;">
            <span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;color:#64748b;font-size:0.7rem;">${isOpen ? "▾" : "▸"}</span>
            ${d.first_author} (${d.year})
          </div>
          <div class="mono" style="color:#64748b;padding-left:12px;">
            ${d.pmid ? `PMID: ${d.pmid}` : d.status === "Preprint" ? "Preprint" : "No PMID"}
          </div>
        </td>
        <td>${d.cohorts_display}</td>
        <td>
          ${d.overlap_count > 0
            ? htl.html`<span class="pg-badge overlap-yes">${d.overlap_compact}</span>`
            : htl.html`<span class="overlap-none">None</span>`}
        </td>
        <td>${d.ancestry_detail}</td>
        <td>${d.sex}</td>
        <td class="num-col"><strong>${d.n_samples.toLocaleString()}</strong></td>
        <td>${d.sample_matrix}</td>
        <td>
          <span class="pg-badge ${platBadgeClass(d.platform_category)}">${d.platform_category}</span>
          <div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#64748b;margin-top:1px;">${d.platform_version}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="num-col">${d.n_assays.toLocaleString()}</td>
        <td><span class="pg-badge ${dataBadgeClass(d.data_label)}">${d.data_label}</span></td>
      </tr>`);

      if (isOpen) {
        trs.push(htl.html`<tr class="detail-row">
          <td colspan="10">
            <div class="detail-topbar">
              <div>
                <p class="detail-title">${d.title}</p>
                <div style="font-size:0.78rem;color:#475569;margin-top:2px;">
                  <em>${d.journal}</em> (${d.year}) · <span class="mono">${d.stratum_id}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="detail-links">
                ${d.doi ? htl.html`<a class="btn-pill" href="https://doi.org/${d.doi}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">DOI: ${d.doi} ↗</a>` : ""}
                ${d.pmid ? htl.html`<a class="btn-pill" href="https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/${d.pmid}/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">PMID: ${d.pmid} ↗</a>` : ""}
                <a class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" href=${d.accession_or_url} target="_blank" rel="noopener">Data Download (${d.repository}) ↗</a>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="detail-3col">
              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>Phenotype Information</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Platform &amp; version:</strong> ${d.platform_version}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Assays measured:</strong> ${d.n_assays.toLocaleString()} assays (${d.n_unique_proteins.toLocaleString()} unique protein targets)</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Sample matrix:</strong> ${d.sample_matrix}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Transformation:</strong> ${d.transformation}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Effect scale:</strong> <span class="mono">${d.effect_scale}</span></div>
              </div>

              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>Genetic Information</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Genome build:</strong> <span class="mono" style="font-weight:700;">${d.genome_build}</span></div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Strand:</strong> <span class="mono" style="font-weight:700;">${d.strand || "Not reported"}</span></div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Model / software:</strong> ${d.gwas_software}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Covariates:</strong> ${d.covariates}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Imputation &amp; scope:</strong> ${d.imputation_panel} · ${d.coverage === "cis_only" ? `Gene-region (±${d.cis_window_kb} kb)` : d.data_label} · Signed EAF: ${d.has_eaf ? "Yes" : "No"} · Indels: <span class="mono">${d.indel_encoding}</span></div>
              </div>

              <div class="detail-col-box">
                <h4>Other Information</h4>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Curation provenance:</strong> <span class="pg-badge ${curationBadgeClass(d.curation_tier)}">${d.curation_tier}</span></div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Overlapping catalogue studies:</strong> ${d.overlap_details}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Data access &amp; format:</strong> ${d.access_level} · ${d.file_format}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Publication status:</strong> ${d.status}${d.superseded_by ? ` (Superseded by ${d.superseded_by})` : ""}</div>
                <div class="detail-kv"><strong>Notes:</strong> ${d.harmonisation_notes}${d.gwasprocessing_yaml ? ` [GWASprocessing: ${d.gwasprocessing_yaml}]` : ""}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>`);
      }
    }

    if (trs.length === 0) {
      trs.push(htl.html`<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align:center;padding:1.5rem;color:#64748b;">No studies match the current column filters.</td></tr>`);
    }
    tbody.replaceChildren(...trs);
  }

  renderRows();

  return htl.html`<div class="pg-shell">
    <div class="hero-banner">
      <div>
        <h1>Proteomic GWAS Catalogue</h1>
        <p>A searchable reference table of published and preprint genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of proteins across cohorts, platforms, and biological matrices.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <a class="btn-pill btn-pill-primary" href="data/proteomic_gwas_catalogue_full.tsv" download>⬇ Download Full Table (.tsv)</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="table-toolbar">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        ${countSpan}
        ${clearBtn}
      </div>
      <label style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.35rem;cursor:pointer;margin:0;">
        ${hideSupCheckbox} Hide superseded preprints
      </label>
    </div>

    <div class="cat-table-wrap">
      <table class="cat-table">
        <thead>
          <tr class="sort-row">${sortHeaders}</tr>
          ${filterRow}
        </thead>
        ${tbody}
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```
